display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 共用 DURA 前向残差路由筛查
description: 同一逐包规则利用 R17 估计的信道作用比较两位专家输出的归一化前向残差，选择残差较小的完整信号；不训练或拟合阈值。
authorization: 用户要求两个数据集使用通用融合方法，优先 R02/R07/R17；显存充足立即启动并保护其他 owner。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI CUDA FP32 / TF32 off, CPU independent scorer

data.contract_ref: lora_rx5_main_v1:392005; ManySig Main original 7/63/30 F0 seed392005; VALIDATED_ONCE source caches
data.representation: same packetwise DURA forward-residual rule, LoRa 8192 and WiSig 256 with independently sourced experts and separately contracted channel operators
data.physical_ids_ref: existing first cross-data screen physical IDs, same paired channel observations
data.exposure: same source V RX panels and historical comparisons repeatedly exposed by prior development; no target input or truth

permissions.claim_scope: Physical selector reads only current packet, two source-trained experts and R17 channel operator; no recognition model in routing or training. Frozen classifier/default head used only to score the resulting signal. No source or target truth, across-packet statistics or fitted threshold. LoRa real-gain expert inherited authorized E104 guidance and pseudolabels; WiSig gain expert is F-free.

checkpoint.initialization: No new trained parameters. Reuse separately source-trained real-gain and R17 experts and the original matching frozen classifier/default head for each dataset.

sources.role: WiSig original full R17 and action
LoRa E104 real-gain screen comparison only
WiSig frozen DURA v1 same-packet screen predictions
frozen same-ID LoRa-trained R69 architecture adaptation; distinct from original WiSig DURA v1 weights

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed rule: scale the current packet and both candidate outputs by current packet RMS, forward both through R17-estimated channel action, select the lower mean squared residual against current packet, ties R17. LoRa low-urban net >=1 each fixed half and clean >=-1 versus every available control; WiSig >=2 each half and clean >=-2. LoRa R69 architecture adaptation is distinct from original WiSig DURA v1.

execution.gpu_policy: Two distinct GPUs from [7,1,6,4], each >=8192 MiB free; excludes GPU 2 and 3 previously used by the source-contrastive run; preserve other owners.
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected run on provenance/data-contract mismatch, occupied immutable output, no source-only checkpoint smoke, nonfinite loss/gradient, prediction matrix mismatch, query or truth-boundary violation; preserve partial artifacts and all other processes.

rows.method: same fixed current-packet DURA channel forward-residual routing of real-gain and R17 expert outputs

data_overrides.training: none; routing uses current packet and source-trained experts, frozen classifier used only for prediction

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.
rows.budget_ref: zero new updates; LoRa repeats R02/R07 action estimation; WiSig executes R17 twice; two action forwards; four frozen default-head forwards for screening predictions

rows.method: same fixed current-packet DURA channel forward-residual routing of real-gain and R17 expert outputs

data_overrides.training: none; routing uses current packet and source-trained experts, frozen classifier used only for prediction

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.

notes: Same physical rule in both datasets; dataset-specific packet adapters and source-trained channel/real-gain experts. No new trainable parameters and no F in selection.

Normalize observed packet by its RMS and estimate R17 action from that observation. Score each entire expert waveform by mean squared difference between the normalized observation and that waveform after the same forward action; choose smaller residual, ties R17. No reference clean, truth, cross-packet statistic or threshold.

WiSig implementation computes R17 at original and normalized scale separately; LoRa repeats the R02/R07 action estimate. Both execute two physical action forwards. Screening uses four default-head forwards for controls and final prediction; measure actual latency and report cost.
LoRa real-gain expert has authorized E104-guided ancestry and pseudolabels; WiSig expert independently source-trained F-free. Frozen classifier/default heads only produce predictions after routing.

Source V panels and prior results repeatedly exposed; target IQ and truth are not accessed in this screen. Fixed observations, controls and advancement threshold are registered before this candidate is scored.
